skillFull: Sets off firecrackers at certain intervals, creating items and Star Candy Jellies. Level Up for more points for Star Candy Jellies and more Energy recovered from Potions created by Crackle Corn.
story: Don't be startled if you suddenly hear firecrackers going off nearby-join in and clap along! It's just Crackle Corn celebrating! This Pet simply can't resist setting off firecrackers whenever something good happens. Candy Corn Cookie was shocked at first when she picked up Crackle Corn, thinking it was just candy she had dropped. But now, as you watch them alternating between blowing their whistle and setting off firecrackers while enjoying the party, it's clear they're a perfect match!

costumes.name: Happy Town Pie Crier
costumes.info: Hear ye, hear ye! Candy Corn Cookie has arrived! Cackle Corn announces her arrival with a distinct POP! before even the scent of the delicious pies can waft through the town. Seems like hungry Cookies should keep an ear open for Cackle Corn's cries!

costumes.name: Star Voyage Signalman
costumes.info: As the very last passenger steps onto the Star Voyage Express, it's time for Crackle Corn to get to work! With a brilliant pop-pop, it alerts everyone to the train's departure. Whenever the tracks seem to twist and warp or the starfog grows too thick, another pop-pop! sets the train right back on the correct path to ensure a safe voyage. It's almost like it was made for this job!
